channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Americans in France: Details of the healthcare charge and making your voice heard
item.description: From the details of the new 'healthcare charge' and why it is harder for young people raised in France to gain citizenship and how to get involved in French politics, here's our latest newsletter for Americans who either live in France, visit frequently or plan to move here some day.

item.title: French court slashes jails term for trio over 2020 teacher beheading
item.description: A French court on Monday reduced on appeal the jail sentences of three men convicted over the 2020 jihadist beheading of a teacher who showed a class cartoons of the Prophet Mohammed.

item.title: The French village where Ayatollah Khomeini fomented Iran's revolution
item.description: It has been nearly 50 years since the Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini recorded speeches calling for an Islamic revolution from a country home in an affluent village west of Paris.

item.title: How to watch the Winter Paralympics in France
item.description: If you're missing your Winter Olympics fix then don't despair - the Paralympics start on Friday. Here's how to watch if you are in France.

item.title: Circumflex: What is the point of the French 'the little hat' accent?
item.description: You might have seen the 'circonflexe' accent also known as the 'little hat' in French words like poêle, être, pâle - but where does it come from and does it serve any purpose in modern French?

item.title: France deploys jets over UAE to protect its military bases
item.description: France has deployed Rafale fighter jets over the United Arab Emirates to protect its naval and air bases against Iranian attacks, Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said Tuesday.

item.title: French word of the day: Paysan
item.description: This French word has several subtle but important differences from its English equivalent.

item.title: Inflation to hit eurozone as war in the Middle East disrupts energy flows
item.description: In the Middle East energy exports to Europe have been disrupted by the conflict between the US, Israel and Iran that has spilled into surrounding regions. Economic experts are predicting a spike in inflation.

item.title: Bill for damage due to south-west France flooding expected to reach €3 billion
item.description: The bill for damage caused by widespread flooding in south-west France is expected to reach €3 billion, with many local authorities reporting difficulty in getting insurance due to the increasingly severe weather.

item.title: Macron to address nation on Middle East war
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron will on Tuesday speak to the nation about the war in Iran and its consequences, the Elysee said, after France vowed to protect its nationals and bases in the Middle East.
